content: The fact that the decoder seems to prefer denser attention distributions might be attributed to it being auto-regressive, only having access to past tokens and not the full sentence. We speculate that it might lose too much information if it assigned weights of zero to too many tokens in the self-attention, since there are fewer tokens to attend to in the first place.
